old_caption: The video captures the dynamic and powerful scene of a waterfall cascading over a rocky cliff. The water flows vigorously, creating a misty spray that rises into the air, partially obscuring the view of the waterfall itself. The mist is diffuse and voluminous, rising from the top of the falls, adding a sense of movement and energy to the scene. The rocks at the edge of the cliff are rugged and uneven, with patches of moss and vegetation clinging to them, indicating a moist environment. The water appears white and turbulent, consistent with a powerful waterfall. The overall atmosphere is one of raw natural beauty and power, with the continuous flow of water dominating the visual experience. There are no visible animals or characters in the frame, allowing the viewer to focus solely on the natural elements. The camera moves downward continuously, revealing more of the cliff face and the falling water as the clip progresses.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures the dynamic and powerful scene of a waterfall cascading over a rocky cliff. The water flows vigorously, creating a misty spray that rises into the air, partially obscuring the view of the waterfall itself. The mist is thick and white, swirling around the base of the falls, adding a sense of movement and energy to the scene. The rocks at the edge of the cliff are rugged and uneven, with patches of moss and vegetation clinging to them, indicating a moist environment. The water appears brownish due to sediment or minerals in the flow, suggesting it might be from a river carrying a lot of silt. The overall atmosphere is one of raw natural beauty and power, with the continuous flow of water dominating the visual experience. There are no visible animals or characters in the frame, allowing the viewer to focus solely on the natural elements. The camera remains steady throughout the sequence, providing a clear and uninterrupted view of the waterfall and its surroundings.
caption: The video captures an aerial close view at the brink of a powerful waterfall plunging into a deep gorge. A dark, moss-topped rock outcrop sits at the edge in the lower portion of the frame, while muddy-white water spills steadily over the lip to its right. A vast, sunlit cloud of spray and mist billows upward from the hidden plunge pool, filling the left and center of the view. Throughout the excerpt the camera tilts and rotates, pointing more steeply down into the chasm. As it does, the rock outcrop drifts toward the bottom-right corner and becomes partly cropped, and the cascading water along the right edge grows larger, occupying more of the frame. The mist churns continuously and turbulently, its billowing texture reshaping and expanding upward as the view descends into it. White froth surges past the rock's edges in a steady, unbroken flow, and the background cliff face on the upper-left shifts position in frame. The flow and mist remain active through the final frame, with no start or end of the process shown.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
